entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

NA HINA RA, AONE BAI NIBITA, NA HORAERE, IAIAU NA REBITA CAU DIBAREA MA IA NOUNA UMUDE HENIA REKE REBITA. NA NIBITA GUVA NA DOA MA IA GOADA IAU NA OGOGAMI NA IA KOHU 'A'.
HORAERE EBEI IDE, IAMA'A DURUA NONOA BAIA, INA M'A AIBO HORAERE.
